component.name: Text Editor
component.summary: Fast, modern desktop text editor with syntax highlighting and code folding

description.p: Wheelhouser Text Editor is a professional desktop text editor built with Python and PySide6. It features native dark mode, tabbed editing, code folding, multi-cursor editing, comprehensive syntax highlighting across dozens of languages, customizable themes, and integrated spell checking.
